confidence_notes: Overall low confidence. No live listings or price pages were checked. These are holistic estimates for July 2026 from general knowledge of Cairo prices in 2024-25, rolled forward for Egyptian inflation and Egyptian pound moves that are hard to pin down. Restaurant and cafe anchors are the firmer part. Hotel anchors have the widest range, July is low season, and it is unclear how many budget places are formally registered. Cocktail and wine were set from the local beer relationship (about 2.2x and 1.8x beer) because direct knowledge is weak. The FX value is the most recent RBA observation I could confirm, taken from search-result copies of the RBA page rather than a direct page read. It is dated 20 March 2026, so it is stale.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Cairo is treated as a large North African tourist city with low USD price levels, estimated from general knowledge and loosely referenced against my general sense of lower-cost North African and Levantine tourist cities. None were checked against current listings.
